name: 94952 · Petaluma, CA
findings: ZIP 94952 (Petaluma) has 185 nonprofit organizations. 88 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 72 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94952 (Petaluma) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 94952 (Petaluma) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 72 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
